literal_meaning: ধ্বনিমুখী শব্দ যা দ্রুত গতির অনুকরণ করে (onomatopoeic sound imitating quick movement)
figurative_meaning_en: indicating a very hasty or speedy manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: তড়তড় করে সিঁড়ি বেয়ে ওপরে উঠে গেল।
সে তড়তড় করে চিঠিটা লিখে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He climbed the stairs in a hasty rush.
She hurriedly wrote the letter in a flash.
note: Often used adverbially with 'করে' to describe quick actions in spoken Bengali.
